text:
Maya: Quick decision needed 1 1 Launch next Thurs. Do we pause the regular newsletter and run a short launch-only sequence + a pre-launch "list health" re-engage? Need a call by EOD.
Priya: pause the regular. run a 3-email launch drip to engaged cohort, and a 2-email re-engage to low-engagement bucket. then prune long-term inactives.
Sam: +1. propose engagement score tiers: Active (opens >=1 in 30d), Warm (opens >=1 in 90d), Cold (no opens 90-365d), Dormant (>365d). Only Active+Warm get full launch drip.
Evan: can ops produce counts for each tier by EOD? need to know send volume and cost.
Priya: re-engage plan: Day0 subject test A/B: A="Quick update from Redwood" B="New low-latency benchmarks inside". Day3 follow-up with single CTA. If no opens by day30 -> add to `pruned_launch_2026`.
Sam: test regional send windows 10am vs 4pm local. track opens and conversions.
Maya: exclude customers, trials <=365d, and webinar RSVPs. Also honor `snooze_opt_out`.
ops: will run export and return counts + suppression CSV. ETA 6pm PT.
marketing-bot: Campaign created: "list-health-and-launch_march_2026" id: cm_2026_listhealth_01 1 assets pending.
Evan: noted. I'll coordinate export with ops and add restore-rule: if re-engage email opened within 48h, include in launch sends.
Maya: final: everyone OK with pause + list-health sweep?
Priya: yes. dropping creative and subject lines in the doc now.
Sam: good to go from me.
Maya: thanks team, i'll send exec note with expected open-rate uplift after pruning.
